name: Arizona Corporation Commission eDocket
known_limitations: The eDocket system can identify utility filings, cases, orders, and public records, but FTFN must cite specific dockets before drawing conclusions about project-level power capacity, water utility obligations, tariffs, or service feasibility.
automation_notes: Search specific company, docket, decision, and document records; follow a selected docket through the ACC Portal where useful. A portal search result is discovery metadata until the underlying filing or order is reviewed.
notes: Phase 55B recheck confirmed the portal, docket search, document search, decisions, reports, calendar, and public follow functions are live. Project Baccara docket L-21369A-25-0222-00253 was selected as the first new bounded facility-level follow-through from this rail.
